summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 System State Baseline: The device experiences intermittent connectivity issues with the Belkin USB WiFi adapter, resulting in frequent disconnections and reconnections. The adapter stalls out after approximately 5 minutes of use, requiring manual intervention to reconnect.
detected_fault: Belkin USB WiFi adapter compatibility issues with Linux Mint 19 Cinnamon, adapter stalls out after 5 minutes of use
suggested_solution: Consider purchasing a new, Linux-compatible USB WiFi adapter or using a bridge and LAN connection as an alternative solution.
